image.subject: 星宇航空「AIRSORAYAMA GOLD」完成交機　B-58554自法國土魯斯啟程返台

zh.title: 星宇航空「AIRSORAYAMA GOLD」完成交機　B-58554自法國土魯斯啟程返台
zh.summary: 星宇航空與日本當代藝術家空山基（Hajime Sorayama）合作打造的「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA GOLD 空山金」已完成交機；A350-1000 B-58554 於 8 月 15 日自土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）啟程返臺，預計 8 月 16 日上午 9 時 28 分抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）。
body: 星宇航空與日本當代藝術家空山基（Hajime Sorayama）合作打造的「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA GOLD 空山金」完成交機。這架註冊編號 B-58554 的 Airbus A350-1000，在法國當地時間 8 月 14 日完成交機程序後，於 8 月 15 日中午 12 時 27 分自土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）啟程飛往臺灣，預計於臺北時間 8 月 16 日上午 9 時 28 分抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）。
B-58554 為星宇航空「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA」藝術計畫中的第二架特別塗裝 A350-1000，採金色為主要視覺元素，與先前交付的「AIRSORAYAMA SILVER 空山銀」B-58553 組成一金一銀的雙機設計。星宇航空於 2026 年 1 月公布這項合作計畫，兩架飛機均以空山基長期創作中具代表性的金屬質感作為設計核心，並將其藝術語彙延伸至大型民航客機機身。
為了在複合材料機身上呈現接近液態金屬的反射效果，相關塗裝並非單純使用傳統金、銀色漆料。星宇航空表示，計畫與 Airbus 及航空塗料業者 Mankiewicz 共同研發，使用高濃度特殊雲母及多層塗佈工法，在符合民航機塗裝與飛航安全要求的前提下，呈現空山基作品中的金屬光澤與視覺層次。
率先完成交付的「空山銀」B-58553 已於 7 月 5 日抵達桃園，並在 7 月 12 日投入首趟載客飛行，執飛臺北至東京成田國際機場（NRT）航線。「空山金」返臺後，意味 AIRSORAYAMA 計畫規劃的兩架金、銀藝術機將正式在臺灣會合。

兩架 AIRSORAYAMA 均採用 A350-1000。這款機型是 Airbus A350 系列中尺寸較大的長程廣體客機版本，使用 Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 發動機；星宇航空將 A350-1000 定位為長程航線主力機型。依星宇航空公布的 AIRSORAYAMA 客艙配置，每架設有 4 席頭等艙、40 席商務艙、36 席豪華經濟艙及 270 席經濟艙，共 350 個座位。
星宇航空在 2026 年 1 月接收旗下首架 A350-1000，成為全球第 11 家營運這款機型的航空公司；Airbus 當時表示，星宇航空共訂購 18 架 A350-1000，作為其擴充歐洲、北美及其他長程航線運能的重要機隊之一。隨著 B-58554 完成交機返臺，AIRSORAYAMA 金、銀雙機也進入完整集結階段。
依目前公布的飛航安排，B-58554 預計於 8 月 16 日上午 9 時 28 分抵達桃園國際機場；實際抵達時間仍可能受到航路、航管及天候等飛航因素影響。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines Completes Delivery of 'AIRSORAYAMA GOLD'; B-58554 Departs Toulouse, France for Taiwan
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines has completed delivery of the A350-1000 B-58554 in its 'AIRSORAYAMA GOLD' livery. The aircraft departed Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) for Taiwan on August 15 and is scheduled to arrive at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 9:28 AM Taipei time on August 16.
body: STARLUX Airlines has completed the delivery of 'STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA GOLD,' created in collaboration with Japanese contemporary artist Hajime Sorayama. Registered B-58554, the Airbus A350-1000 officially completed delivery procedures on August 14 local time in France and departed Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) for Taiwan at 12:27 PM on August 15. It is scheduled to arrive at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 9:28 AM Taipei time on August 16.

B-58554 is the second specially-liveried A350-1000 in STARLUX Airlines' 'STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA' art project, featuring gold as its primary visual element to form a gold-and-silver dual-aircraft concept paired with the previously delivered 'AIRSORAYAMA SILVER' (B-58553). STARLUX Airlines unveiled this collaboration project in January 2026, with both aircraft centered on the signature metallic texture from Hajime Sorayama's long-standing artistic oeuvre, extending his visual language onto the fuselages of large commercial passenger aircraft.

To achieve a liquid-metal-like reflective effect on the composite airframe, the livery does not merely rely on traditional gold or silver paints. STARLUX Airlines stated that the project collaborated with Airbus and aviation coatings specialist Mankiewicz to develop a process using high-concentration special mica and multi-layer application techniques, presenting the metallic luster and visual depth characteristic of Sorayama's artwork while strictly complying with commercial aircraft painting and flight safety requirements.

The first to be delivered, 'AIRSORAYAMA SILVER' B-58553, arrived at Taoyuan on July 5 and entered revenue passenger service on July 12, operating the route between Taipei and Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT). The return of 'AIRSORAYAMA GOLD' to Taiwan signifies that the two gold and silver art aircraft planned under the AIRSORAYAMA project will officially reunite in Taiwan.

Both AIRSORAYAMA aircraft utilize the A350-1000. This model is the larger long-range widebody passenger aircraft variant in the Airbus A350 family, powered by Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines; STARLUX Airlines positions the A350-1000 as the flagship aircraft for its long-haul routes. According to the AIRSORAYAMA cabin configuration released by STARLUX Airlines, each aircraft features a total of 350 seats, configured with 4 First Class seats, 40 Business Class seats, 36 Premium Economy seats, and 270 Economy Class seats.

STARLUX Airlines took delivery of its first A350-1000 in January 2026, becoming the 11th airline globally to operate this model; Airbus stated at the time that STARLUX Airlines ordered a total of 18 A350-1000s as a core fleet element to expand capacity on routes to Europe, North America, and other long-haul destinations. With B-58554 completing delivery and returning to Taiwan, the AIRSORAYAMA gold and silver dual-aircraft fleet enters its full assembly stage.

According to current flight schedules, B-58554 is expected to arrive at Taoyuan International Airport at 9:28 AM on August 16; actual arrival times remain subject to operational flight factors such as routing, air traffic control, and weather conditions.
